passages.text: But news of the Haganah conquest of Haifa (and Tiberias) spurred the IZL to seek a victory of its own,164 and no objective was more attractive than Jaffa, which bordered on Tel Aviv, the IZL's main base of recruitment and operations, which for months had endured sniping from Jaffa's northern neighborhoods.

srcNote: Aggregate sniping — no casualty figure in any source. New detail is the outcome: it motivated the IZL assault on Jaffa/Manshiya beginning 25 April 1948.
